title: Three-candidate rankings and nonconstant signs
statement: Let $w$ assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each of the three pairwise contests among three candidates. Then $w$ is the vector of pairwise preferences arising from some strict ranking of the candidates if and only if its three signs are not all equal.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ assigns a sign to each of the three pairwise contests
